text: EDG start: automatic on loss of both normal supplies of 00BMA10 (undervoltage 0.7 pu for 2 s), first supply within 10 s, sequential loading by priority. The largest single step shall not cause a voltage dip above 15 % or a frequency dip above 10 % (ISO 8528-5 class G3), and the loading shall not exceed 80 % of the standby rating. Test start weekly with no load and monthly on load without interruption of supply.
